metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace name

properties.description:
Monitors data ingestion for infrequent tables.
Query to display recent events:

let _step = 7d;
let lookback = 14d;
union isfuzzy=true
SecurityAlert,
SecurityIncident
| make-series count() default=0 on TimeGenerated from bin(ago(lookback),_step) to bin(now(),_step) step _step by Type
| render  timechart
